name: Gadgetzan Water Survey
summary: Gadgetzan needs water, and Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser is searching the desert for a new source. The Gadgetzan Water Company has lost every well to the nomads, so Fizzledowser hires you to sample a pool near Sandsorrow Watch.

sections.title: A Company in Need of Water
sections.body: The Gadgetzan Water Company has lost every well to the nomads. Now Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser hopes to find other free sources in the desert, but the search calls for a survey. The company needs a temporary junior-grade surveyor to help.

sections.title: Sampling at Sandsorrow Watch
sections.body: Fizzledowser gives you an untapped dowsing widget and sends you to the pool near Sandsorrow Watch. It lies due west of Gadgetzan and south of Zul'Farrak, within view of nearby trolls. Use the widget to tap a water sample, then return it to Fizzledowser.

sections.title: Back With Fizzledowser
sections.body: Fizzledowser learns that a bad mojo creepy-crawly ambushed you on the return journey. Reports have also described crazy bug-creatures sucking up the desert's water. Fizzledowser first dismissed the reports as nonsense, likely more trouble from the nomads. Now the truth is known.

faq.q: Who offers the survey work in Gadgetzan?
faq.answer: Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser is hiring a temporary junior-grade surveyor for the Gadgetzan Water Company.

faq.q: Why is the Gadgetzan Water Company searching for new pools?
faq.answer: The nomads have seized every well belonging to the company, so it needs other free sources of water.

faq.q: Where is the pool to be sampled located?
faq.answer: The pool near Sandsorrow Watch lies due west of Gadgetzan and south of Zul'Farrak, within view of nearby trolls.

faq.q: What tool is provided for gathering the sample?
faq.answer: You use a dowsing widget at the pool to tap a water sample.
This begins a chain that continues with the Noxious Lair Investigation.
